facts.claim: The Australian Embassy in Athens lists among its notarial services witnessing application forms for, and issuing, Certificates of No Impediment to Marriage (CNI), and witnessing notices of intended marriage.

The Australian Embassy in Athens says an appointment is required for all notarial services, though Apostille and CNI documents can be submitted by post; CNIs are available for collection within two working days.
The Australian Embassy in Athens charges notarial service fees (published on its fees page); honorary consuls cannot provide notarial services.
The Australian Embassy in Athens says it does not provide legal advice and that clients are responsible for knowing which service they need.

Smartraveller (updated 18/08/2026): some countries require proof you are free to marry; the most common documents are a CNI and certificates from a registry of births, deaths and marriages; contact the destination's embassy for specific requirements.

Smartraveller: ask whether you need a CNI, whether it can be obtained in Australia, and whether it needs an authentication or apostille; some local authorities only accept CNIs issued in their country.
Smartraveller: an overseas marriage cannot be registered in Australia but is in most cases legally recognised if it was valid where it took place and would have been valid under Australian law.
Smartraveller: a foreign marriage certificate is usually accepted as proof of marriage but may not be accepted as proof of a name change; check with your state registry.

insider_details.detail: Greece is at Smartraveller's lowest level ('Exercise normal safety precautions', updated 30 September 2026), but summer brings wildfire and heatwave risk from June to September, so build a heat and fire contingency into midsummer dates.
Greek-Australian couples should get advice from a Greek embassy or consulate before travelling, because people of Greek descent born overseas may be Greek nationals with obligations.
Tell guests to pack a cover-up: Smartraveller asks visitors to dress modestly in churches, which matters for an Orthodox ceremony in summer.
Allow for Schengen and EES border checks when timing guest arrivals close to the wedding day.
